details:
had this issue happen more than 7 times in less than a week.

1open vrchat ( web browsers with tabs in background) and antivirus (not scanning)

2join world talk etc... 200-400 ping average which is normal for my reign (been like that for almost 2 years)

task manager shows an average of 191 programs running.

about 2 gb or ram overhead in task manager

pc avartars pc world (but the crash happened in any world)

almost all avatars are hidden (robot) except friends

3 Ping spikes to above 1000 and PC lags  

4 aspect ratio and scale changes

5 vrchat and desktop goes blank/ black no response to input

breif moment flash minimize  tap icon on opposite side of screen (older 'looking' version of windows)

windows notification sound play

6 sometimes not always. last 5 seconds of gameplay audio loops at same time

7 forced shutdown by cutting power

-local service provider outage happend day 3 of these bugs repeatedly happening

-drive sata cable was replaced a few days prior to first bug for intermediate drive failure 

- system memory was checked ok (built-in windows)

-windows system built-in disc cleaner and repair was used. command prompt and safe mode, both checked drive as ok with no errors.

- Event viewer at the time of the bug ' "usermodepowerservice" vrmonitor.exe ID 8984 was "reset policy scheme from...."

  

for the full log and more detail contact me through user    info in detailed bio
title: game plays as usual But occasionally spikes above 1500 ping once this happens the PC freeze and vrchat goes black screen (audio loops last 5 seconds of connection) and no way to close the application. other than powering down the PC
